integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic surreal body horror, photorealistic. <Subject 1> stands facing the camera in a tiled changing room at a public swimming pool, framed from the waist up, moving naturally. The camera pushes in at slow speed. A subtle stiffness begins in the neck: <Subject 1> turns the head and it stops almost instantly, with unusual precision. <Subject 1> raises one hand; the fingers settle into exact angles, each small adjustment producing a faint crystalline tension. <Subject 1> rotates carefully, and a fine hairline fracture appears across the skin near the wrist and travels a few centimetres before stopping. <Subject 1> notices it and becomes extremely careful, lowering the arm with slow controlled movement. Each breath now barely lifts the chest. A thin fracture forms at the temple and branches slowly across the cheek in a beautiful pattern, dividing into finer lines around the jaw. <Subject 1> freezes. Only the eyes move, toward the camera. In the final moment a final tiny crack advances a few millimetres beneath one eye, and <Subject 1> becomes even more still.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room ambience, shallow careful breathing, delicate crystalline tension, and tiny high-pitched crackling as each fracture travels.
